systems.system: 5151 hotline (DPCR SA, via La Poste de Djibouti call centre)

DJI.note: Hotline is a road company's own customer service, not a financial regulator's complaints body.
Road-fee payment is not a cross-border digital payment channel.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: DPCR SA announced that the road-use fee on the Djibouti-Ethiopia corridor is now paid by Mobile Money, with cash no longer accepted at collection points.

systems.system: DPCR SA road-use fee payment by Mobile Money

DJI.note: Fee is collected by a corridor company; document does not say it is a state tax or fee.
